name: s3:GetObject scoped (negative)
note: s3:GetObject on a single scoped bucket prefix is routine and must NOT fire DATA-EXFIL: the bulk-read rule requires a broad resource scope. Guards the "on *" boundary of the exfil rule. IAM-706: it must ALSO NOT fire DATA-READ - the bucket name (reports-bucket) is neutral (no sensitivity token) and the ARN carries no policy variable, so a routine scoped read stays quiet.
